item.title: Uplifting coffee, heavy burdens: Nabak farmers find new hope with Homestate partnership
item.description: For decades, farmers in Nabak have battled rough mountain trails and steep terrain, carrying their coffee bags to Bambok, the end of the road, where they can access vehicles or PMVs to transport their coffee to Lae.
